env CGO_ENABLED=0

# With cgo off, a package whose import "C" files need cgo (here, a #cgo
# directive) is excluded, as with Go.
! go install cgotest
stderr 'build constraints exclude all Go files'

# gd: one that needs only what cmd/cc provides is built by cc instead.
cd ../cctest
go install cctest

-- go.mod --
module cgotest

go 1.16
-- m.go --
package cgotest

// #cgo CFLAGS: -DX
import "C"

var _ C.int
-- ../cctest/go.mod --
module cctest

go 1.16
-- ../cctest/m.go --
package cctest

import "C"

var _ C.int
